newsitem.title: USA: Research Medical acquired by Baxter.
newsitem.headline: Research Medical acquired by Baxter.

text.p: Baxter International Inc said Friday that Research Medical Inc's shareholders have approved the acquisition of the company by Baxter.

As previously announced, Baxter will exchange 0.4985 share of Baxter stock for each of the 9.6 million Research Medical common shares outstanding. The transaction, which includes the cashout of all existing options, is valued at about $236 million.

Salt Lake City, Utah-based Research Medical is a diversified medical device company specializing in developing, manufacturing and selling hospital disposable products for cardiovascular and vascular surgery.
Baxter is a global medical-products and services company.
